method: Two independent read-only pre-edit reviews; coordinator implemented targeted guidance and verified source provenance.

findings.gap: Controller OS/tool presence was not explicitly separated from remote execution capability.
findings.repair: Single execution context records host, OS/architecture/shell, cwd, resolved tool, configuration and target; refresh only changed facts.

findings.gap: Commands lacked a reusable prerequisites/deadline/result/recovery contract.
findings.repair: Command records capture exact argv, execution context, side effects, expected exit/output and postcondition; documented error classification and uncertain-outcome reconciliation.

findings.gap: Configured selection, live identity and actual permission could be conflated.
findings.repair: Scoped provider patterns and explicit target binding; mismatch blocks mutation without automatic login/account switch.

findings.gap: Untrusted kubeconfig credential plugins were not called out.
findings.repair: Inspect credential exec trust before API use; explicit context flags do not make a malicious helper safe.

findings.gap: Formatting, dependency initialization, validation, detailed plan exits and apply identity were not sufficiently distinct.
findings.repair: Document installed dependencies, non-JSON early failures, 0/1/2 plan meanings, sensitive saved plans and context/state compatibility.

findings.gap: Login discovery, scheduler RPCs, syntax validation and allocated GPU execution were not operationally separated.
findings.repair: Host-specific scoped commands, module preservation, no automatic staging assumption, batch environment/paths, and actual driver/toolkit/MPI proof.
